_original_lore: The Golden Ghoul is a mob added in the Slayer
update. It spawns accompanied by Crypt Ghouls
and spawns at the deepest part of the Coal Mine.
The Golden Ghoul's appearance is of a zombie wearing
Golden Armor holding a Golden Sword.
name: 黄金食尸鬼 (怪物)

source: The Golden Ghoul is a mob added in the Slayer
update. It spawns accompanied by Crypt Ghouls
and spawns at the deepest part of the Coal Mine.
loreParagraphs.translation: 黄金食尸鬼是杀手更新中加入的怪物.它生成时伴随地穴食尸鬼,并生成在煤矿的最深处.

source: The Golden Ghoul's appearance is of a zombie wearing
Golden Armor holding a Golden Sword.
loreParagraphs.translation: 黄金食尸鬼的外观是一个穿着金盔甲、手持金剑的僵尸.
